[[Gabrial Atanna]] lived in an '''estate''' in a quiet suburb of [[Calamar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] with his [[Gabrial Atanna's wife|wife]] following his retirement from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. After Atanna's arrest by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on charges of [[Spy/Legends|spying]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], his wife and grandchildren were held under house arrest in the estate until rescued by Alliance forces.
